usage.outputShape: body.url (mp4 video URL); also body.model, body.duration, body.cost, body.success, body.paymentSettlement.transaction
quirks: Synchronous: the paid 200 response directly contains the finished video URL at body.url (a Vercel blob .mp4) — no job id, no polling.
Flat $1.00 per call (x402 on Base USDC); generates a 5s Google Veo 3 Fast video.
Response echoes on-chain settlement at body.paymentSettlement.transaction.
usage.guide: Call POST https://gen.portalfoundation.ai/api/generate-video with JSON body {"prompt":"<your text prompt>"} and pay the x402 charge ($1.00 USDC on Base). The call is synchronous — the 200 response returns the finished 5-second video at body.url (a public .mp4 blob URL). Read body.url to fetch/download the generated video; body.model (veo3-fast) and body.duration confirm the result. No auth, no polling, no template params.
